{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Continuous Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-javascript:
    name: JavaScript Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        id: setup-node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Dependencies
        id: npm-ci
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check Format
        id: npm-format-check
        run: npm run format:check

      - name: Lint
        id: npm-lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Test
        id: npm-ci-test
        run: npm run ci-test

  test-action:
    name: GitHub Actions Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        id: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Test Local Action
        id: test-action
        uses: ./
        with:
          milliseconds: 2000

      - name: Print Output
        id: output
        run: echo "${{ steps.test-action.outputs.time }}"",
  "rationale": "The workflow currently has no job-level timeouts, which can lead to runaway CI runs consuming excess resources. Evidence from experiment 'experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508' (pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) shows a measured 26.8% elapsed time reduction by adding a 5-minute timeout to a similar Node.js job. The pattern catalog also reports estimated VM time reductions of 12.9% (free) and 8.1% (paid) for custom timeouts. The repository's recent successful runs (CI history) suggest typical job durations are well under the proposed limits (10 minutes for the heavier test-javascript job, 5 minutes for the lightweight test-action job), providing operational headroom while preserving all build and test coverage.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
